assets.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable location reference, conv_store/key.png, entry L14. Generate one full-bleed landscape PNG at exactly 1536 × 1024 pixels, 3:2. Recipe: establish; a wide, detailed location key; camera across the empty street at height 1.6 m, looking diagonally at a small corner convenience store in Mangwon, Seoul, just after midnight. One camera, one level horizon, coherent two-point architecture perspective. Calm upper area is the plain dark upper facade and sky.

Input image 1 is an APPROVED house-style reference ONLY: use its crisp ink and disciplined cel colouring. Do not copy any people, costumes, weapons, letter T, staging, stone architecture or night-blue lighting from it. The requested location and camera below determine the new image.

Scene: a bright little independent neighbourhood convenience store occupies the ground floor of a modest low-rise corner building. The main glass storefront faces us, the building's narrow right side recedes down a quiet side street. A plain muted dark-teal awning, underside 2.5 m above pavement, covers two simple pale plastic square tables and several plain plastic chairs on the main frontage. Tables 0.72 m high; chair seats 0.44 m, backs 0.85 m. Keep a clear walking route and realistic clearance from wall and curb. Main glass entrance, 2.1 m high, is toward the RIGHT of this frontage; large shop windows to its LEFT. Through the left window is a vertical white-framed drinks fridge, lit from inside, with orderly plain bottles and cans. Through the right window one can glimpse the rear-right checkout counter and a small wall-mounted TV ABOVE the counter, its unobscured screen a perfectly flat solid #00FF00 rectangle. Do not add other screens or displays. Plain fascia above awning has NO letters, symbols, brand stripes or logo; all product labels are blank colour blocks without even tiny writing.

Key light: visible white fluorescent ceiling tubes inside the store, #E8F0F4, spilling through the windows and across the outdoor tables; drinks fridge softly illuminated with ordinary white light. ONE streetlamp at the right corner, its warm-white lamp head visible high in frame, provides a small secondary pool at the curb. Street and upper building sit in muted slate/navy grey-blue night shadows; crisp restrained glass reflections, no whole-scene glow. Asphalt is matte with a few faint reflective patches, no heavy rain or added dramatic effects. No vehicles or crowds.

Scale people: exactly TWO tiny anonymous adults in the distant side-street middle ground, each less than 9% of the canvas height, full-length, correctly built at 7.5 heads with long legs, in plain muted grey everyday clothing, walking with feet firmly on the pavement. They share the same horizon and pavement plane, heads near the camera horizon. They are incidental scale markers, no faces or character identities, no orange vest or weapons. All outdoor tables remain unoccupied and clear for later story scenes. Preserve the full-detail architecture and readable furniture silhouettes at phone size; highest contrast belongs to the store's lit frontage.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
